_comment: 2018M JSON join script for the Lo revival. See wiki/articles/infrastructure/api/joinscript.md. The 2016+ Roblox client expects this JSON as the body of /Game/PlaceLauncher.ashx when a player joins. Older 2012-era clients use the Lua variant (gameserver.lua).
_source: Written from the wiki spec + Finobe/Fobe patterns. Not copy-pasted from any leaked source.
_apex: gazeee.xyz (10 chars, exact drop-in for roblox.com per wiki/general-tips.md)

_placeholders.__JOB_ID__: Replaced at delivery time with the actual jobId from RCC OpenJob
_placeholders.__PLACE_ID__: Replaced at delivery time with the actual placeId
_placeholders.__SERVER_IP__: Replaced at delivery time with the RCC-spawned child process IP
_placeholders.__SERVER_PORT__: Replaced at delivery time with the RCC-spawned child process port
_placeholders.__USERNAME__: Replaced at delivery time with the joining user's name
_placeholders.__USER_ID__: Replaced at delivery time with the joining user's ID
_placeholders.__CLIENT_TICKET__: The auth ticket the client just received from /Login/Negotiate.ashx
